about: Peshwa Wheat Limited runs a flour-milling unit at Bijepur, Indore (Madhya Pradesh) with 56,100 MTPA installed capacity. It makes atta, sortex wheat, broken wheat, wheat bran, besan and maize flour, and also trades some vegetables. It sells B2B through super stockists and directly to bulk buyers, mainly in Madhya Pradesh (97% of FY26 revenue).
sector: Food Processing - Flour Milling / Agri Commodities

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure - purchase of plant and machinery
General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of gross proceeds or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Business began as partnership firm M/s Peshwa Wheat (deed dated Sept 13, 2017); converted into a public limited company on Dec 26, 2023. Post-issue holding computed from 99,68,000 shares over 1,90,28,196 shares.

concentration.note: FY26: top customer 18.89%, top 5 64.14%, top 10 71.14% of revenue. Madhya Pradesh is 97.21% of revenue. Promoter-group firm Peshwa Bakers bought Rs 9.58 crore (4.44%).

litigation_note: No criminal or regulatory actions disclosed against the company. A GST scrutiny notice of Rs 82,033 is pending; indirect tax demand of Rs 4.75 crore is shown as a contingent liability at Mar-26.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 171.54 crore in FY25 to Rs 215.94 crore in FY26 (26% growth) and PAT rose 34% to Rs 15.81 crore.
Reported RoCE of 33.44% and RoNW of 36.71% in FY26, well above the two listed peers (RoNW 4.6% and 9.0%).
Operates an integrated processing unit with ISO 22000 certification and FSSAI state and central licences.
Plan to nearly double capacity from 56,100 to 1,02,600 MTPA; existing capacity was about 90% utilised in FY26.
Net worth increased from Rs 27.26 crore to Rs 43.06 crore and cash rose to Rs 17.65 crore in FY26.
Inventory turnover of 7.16 times and current ratio of 2.07 in FY26 indicate healthy working-capital movement.
Sells through super stockists and direct bulk buyers, giving two sales channels (53% and 47% of FY26 revenue).
By-products such as wheat bran are sold, giving a zero-waste operation.

risks.title: Very high customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers made 71.14% of FY26 revenue and top 5 made 64.14%; the top customer alone is 18.89%. Loss of any major buyer would hurt sales.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on one state
risks.detail: Madhya Pradesh gave 97.21% of FY26 revenue (93.32% in FY25), and 100% of raw materials (wheat, chana dal, maize) are bought from Madhya Pradesh.

risks.title: Related-party dealings
risks.detail: Sales of Rs 9.58 crore to Peshwa Bakers in FY26 (receivable Rs 3.95 crore) and related-party purchases of Rs 75.75 crore in FY26 (Rs 84.70 crore in FY25) from promoter-group entities, about 40% of material costs.

risks.title: Negative and volatile operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 13.10 crore in FY25 as receivables and inventory ballooned; FY26 turned positive at Rs 15.64 crore, mostly from working-capital release.

risks.title: High debt and working-capital reliance
risks.detail: Borrowings were Rs 23.74 crore at Mar-26 (Rs 22.60 crore Mar-25), almost all short-term; receivables were Rs 28.07 crore. Unsecured loans from promoters are repayable on demand.

risks.title: Thin margins and commodity price risk
risks.detail: PAT margin is only 7.32% and EBITDA margin 10.53% in FY26; wheat, chana and maize prices and quality vary with weather and crop conditions.

risks.title: Company history and compliance lapses
risks.detail: Operated as a partnership firm until Dec 2023, so listed-company track record is short; several RoC forms (MR-1, CHG-1, MGT-14) were filed late, and a Rs 4.75 crore indirect tax demand is a contingent liability.

risks.title: Leased premises and unfunded expansion risk
risks.detail: Registered office, plant and warehouses are leased, not owned; Rs 26.50 crore of the issue goes to working capital and expansion orders for machinery are not yet placed.

notes: Standalone restated figures (Indian GAAP), Rs lakh converted to Rs crore. Company was a partnership firm until Dec 25, 2023; Mar-24 P&L (revenue, EBITDA, PBT, PAT, other income) combines the Apr-Dec 2023 firm period and Dec 26 2023-Mar 2024 company period, matching the RHP's combined FY24 figures (revenue Rs 88.13 crore). Mar-24 operating cash flow left null (split-period cash flow table garbled). Mar-24 ROCE, ROE, debt/equity and current ratio are the post-conversion period-ended values reported in the KPI table. EPS and NAV are post-bonus. Price band, issue size in Rs, and P/E are blank in this RHP; general corporate purposes amount not yet fixed. Issue is fresh issue of 52,99,200 shares (including 2,95,200 market maker shares) on BSE SME; reservation is not-more-than 50% QIB, not-less-than 15% NII and 35% retail of the net issue.
